    Out-of-Sample Forecasting for the Phillips Curve State-Space Model

    forecast_philips_ssm.Rd

    Generates recursive out-of-sample inflation forecasts across rolling vintage origins using structural Phillips curve state-space estimates, projected HP output gaps, and spliced Law of One Price (LOP) gaps.

    forecast_philips_ssm(
  params_df,
  date_col = "quarter",
  master_df,
  forecast_h = 8,
  exogenous_gdp_forecast_data
)

    Arguments

    params_df

    A data frame containing filtered parameters across quarters (natural_rate, beta_y, psi_lop, phi).

    date_col

    Character. Column name identifying quarterly dates. Defaults to "quarter".

    master_df

    A data frame containing historical quarterly series, including log_inflation_diff.

    forecast_h

    Integer. Out-of-sample forecast horizon in quarters. Defaults to 8.

    exogenous_gdp_forecast_data

    A data frame containing real-time GDP forecast vintages.

    Value

    A data frame formatted as a lower-triangular forecast matrix where the first column is date_col (target quarters) and subsequent columns represent vintage origins.

    Details

    At each quarterly vintage origin \(T\), headline inflation is projected recursively using a New Keynesian Hybrid Open-Economy Phillips curve specification: $$\hat{\pi}_{T+h|T} = \bar{\pi}_{T|T} + \phi (\hat{\pi}_{T+h-1|T} - \bar{\pi}_{T|T}) + \psi_{\text{LOP}} \, \text{gap}^{\text{LOP}}_{T+h} + \beta_y \, y^{\text{gap}}_{T+h}$$ where \(\bar{\pi}_{T|T}\) is the filtered latent trend inflation rate and \(\hat{\pi}_{T|T}\) is initialized from observed inflation at the vintage boundary.

    See also

    get_hp_gap, splice_snb_series
